sanitized_failure: The Docker daemon ran in a separate container namespace. Controller filesystem paths supplied as nested-container bind mounts were therefore absent or root-created inside the daemon container; OpenCode could not create its home directory.
deterministic_repair: Mount the exact same shared bind-root, workspace, and SFS volumes at identical paths in the evaluator and Docker-daemon containers. Use the shared bind root for the offline agent-home startup test.
successor_policy: Run an inner-container startup diagnostic against the shared-mount topology, then use a new create-once output root and dedicated database.
